# IFleetCommanderRewardsManagerFactory
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/IFleetCommanderRewardsManagerFactory.sol)

**Title:**
IFleetCommanderRewardsManagerFactory

Interface for the FleetCommanderRewardsManagerFactory contract

Defines the interface for creating new FleetCommanderRewardsManager instances


## Functions
### createRewardsManager

Creates a new FleetCommanderRewardsManager instance


```solidity
function createRewardsManager(address accessManager, address fleetCommander) external returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`accessManager`|`address`|Address of the access manager to associate with the rewards manager|
|`fleetCommander`|`address`|Address of the fleet commander to associate with the rewards manager|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|Address of the newly created rewards manager|


## Events
### RewardsManagerCreated
Event emitted when a new rewards manager is created


```solidity
event RewardsManagerCreated(address indexed rewardsManager, address indexed fleetCommander);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardsManager`|`address`|Address of the newly created rewards manager|
|`fleetCommander`|`address`|Address of the fleet commander associated with the rewards manager|
